# pi-plan-mode, Prism fork

Fork (roadmap V2.14) of the published npm package `@narumitw/pi-plan-mode` 0.58.3
(`sha512-mC2dOLXrsLedLH4VrX0t3wwdXrr9AccoI8SgvYYn0KewaR6hZ0a6fIyLnReVlnJ4zNcjhdwBKWujrM49EW4zsg==`,
https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions, `packages/pi-plan-mode/`, MIT). The files are the
published package with small patches in `dist/`, each marked `// prism-fork:`; `src/` is the
published source, unchanged and not loaded.

Its dependencies resolve from `../../node_modules/` (see `../../README.md`).

## Changes from 0.58.3

| Change | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Plan mode toggles with `alt+p` unless `toggleShortcut` in `pi-plan-mode.json` chooses another key | `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` (`configuredPlanModeToggleShortcut`) | The owner asked for a keybind to toggle Plan mode, like opencode (QA report, 2026-10-13) |
| The tool lists of `/plan` and `/plan settings` show only the tools Plan mode can use; blocked, inactive and deprecated tools are summed up in one disabled diagnostic line that names them | `dist/index.ts` (`showLaunchMenu`), `dist/chunks/interactive-ui-OZA4BHGS.ts` (`defaultToolItems`) | Most tools were listed as "built-in blocked" or not active, some as DEPRECATED (QA report) |
| The toggle and its key are published on `globalThis[Symbol.for("prism.plan-mode")]` | `dist/index.ts` (`initializePlanModeShortcut`) | Prism's composer shows a clickable Plan switch that runs the same toggle (owner's QA report: switch modes by clicking) |
| Whether plan mode is on is published with the toggle (`enabled`) | `dist/index.ts` (`initializePlanModeShortcut`) | `/init` offers to plan first in plan mode only when it is off (fork.10.5, owner's QA of 2026-11-07) |
| Bash: redirections to `/dev/null` and between stdout and stderr (`2>/dev/null`, `2>&1`) are removed before the check; `antiword`, `catdoc`, `pdftotext FILE -`, `unzip -p`/`-l` and `pandoc` without output, filter, defaults or Lua options are allowed | `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` (`stripHarmlessRedirections`, `isSafeDocumentExtractor`) | A model reading .doc/.docx files in Plan mode was refused every extractor and every `2>/dev/null`, then read the files as raw bytes and overflowed its context (owner's export, 2026-10-21; hotfix 1.0.0-fork.8) |
| Bash: `cd` is allowed, so a model does not have to rewrite each command with absolute paths | `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` | QA of fork.9: a model spent turns working around it |
| A blocked bash command's reason lists what Plan mode allows | `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` (`PLAN_MODE_BASH_HINT`), `dist/index.ts` | Same session: eight refusals in a row, each without saying what would pass |
| Each menu definition goes through `globalThis[Symbol.for("prism.translateMenu")]` before `pi-tui-kit` draws it | `dist/chunks/interactive-ui-OZA4BHGS.ts` (`defineMenu` at each kit import) | The Plan menus were in English in a French profile (QA of fork.8, UX-17). Prism translates the shown texts (`src/fork/menu-i18n.ts`) |
| `ui.notify` goes through `globalThis[Symbol.for("prism.translateUi")]` (`prismUi`) | `dist/index.ts`, `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts`, `dist/chunks/interactive-ui-OZA4BHGS.ts` | Same report: the plug-in's own notifications stayed in English (fork.9 register, UX-17) |
| Fixed widget and status texts go through `prism.translateUi` as plain strings (`prismText`); a label built around a value is one exact catalog entry with named slots filled by the plug-in (`prismFill`: tool policy, counts with a singular, "same as plan", the policy summaries); the widget wraps instead of cutting a line | `dist/index.ts` (`updatePlanModeUi`, `renderPlanModeWidget`, `formatToolSummary`, tool summary), `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` (`toolPolicyLabel`), `dist/chunks/interactive-ui-OZA4BHGS.ts` (settings values, model and thinking labels) | The widget and compound labels stayed in English, and a French line was cut at 64 columns (UX-17). No catch-all pattern: a tool name, model or value is never translated |
| pi-tui-kit's own texts ("Type to search", "(unavailable)", "No matching items"…) go through `prism.translateKitText` from a theme proxy (`prismMenuContext`, all `runMenu` calls) | `dist/chunks/interactive-ui-OZA4BHGS.ts` | The kit draws them itself, outside any menu definition. Prism translates only an allowlist of exact texts, prefixes and suffixes (`src/fork/menu-i18n.ts`); any other text passes unchanged |
| The mode contract is stored as a session message when a prompt is sent, if the mode changed, not at each toggle (`enterPlanMode`, `exitPlanMode`, `rollbackNewActivation`, `input` handler); the `context` handler already gives the model the right contract for a turn started any other way | `dist/index.ts` | QA of 2026-11-01: each press of the Plan switch stored the whole contract, so pressing it in a loop filled the context |
| Plan mode turned on then off before any prompt leaves no contract: Normal mode needs one only after a Plan contract the model saw (`contractsRelevantBeforePlan`) | `dist/index.ts` (`enterPlanMode`, `exitPlanMode`) | Owner's QA of fork.11 (2026-11-14): in an empty session, a Normal contract about a Plan mode the model never saw made it call `plan_mode_complete` in a loop |
| `package.json`: `@narumitw/pi-tui-kit` pinned to the vendored 0.59.0 (was `^0.59.0`) | `package.json` | The repository requires exact versions (`npm run check`) |
| `session_search` is a read-only tool in Plan mode; in bash, `$?` (the previous command's exit status) is not an expansion that blocks the command, also inside double quotes | `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` (`SAFE_BUILTIN_PLAN_TOOLS`, `hasShellExpansion`, `PLAN_MODE_BASH_HINT`) | Owner's decision, 2026-11-05 (D12): the QA of fork.9 saw `session_search` and `echo "exit=$?"` refused while they only read |
| The Plan switch bridge (`Symbol.for("prism.plan-mode")`) is published again at each session start and removed at the instance's shutdown when it is still that instance's | `dist/index.ts` (`initializePlanModeShortcut`, `session_shutdown`) | Disabled then reloaded, the module left its bridge: `/init` offered to plan first and `toggle_plan` answered `toggled: true` through the unloaded instance (Codex review CR-234) |
| Bash: options that write or run a program are refused inside a cluster of short options and as an abbreviated long option (`sort -uo FILE`, `sort --o=FILE`, `tree -ao FILE`, `fd -Hx CMD`, `pandoc -so FILE`, `pandoc --filte=PROG`), sed scripts given by `-e` or `-f` are refused (`w FILE`, `e CMD`), `unzip` needs its list or pipe mode before the archive, `bat cache` is refused | `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` (`UNSAFE_OPTIONS`, `hasUnsafeOption`, `hasSafeArguments`, `isSafeDocumentExtractor`) | Review of the modules the Codex review did not read (2026-11-12): each wrote a file or ran a program when tried in a throwaway folder |
| Bash: an interpreter passes only with `--version` (or `-V`) as its only argument; `rg --hostname-bin` is refused; `npm test`/`npm run` and the test runners (`cargo`, `go`, `pytest`, `vitest`, `jest`) accept only the options of a list (`PRISM_NPM_SCRIPT_OPTIONS`, `PRISM_TEST_OPTIONS`, `hasOnlyOptions`) | `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` | Security audit of fork.12, AS-019: `python3 -c CODE --version`, `go test -exec PROG`, `cargo test --config`, `npm test --script-shell=PROG`, `pytest --basetemp=DIR` and `vitest --outputFile` wrote a file or ran a program |
| A configured safe subcommand (`safeSubcommands`) covers its own segment, checked like the others for expansions; it covered the whole command | `dist/chunks/chunk-L2CXUWCH.ts` (`findBlockedCommandSegment`, `findBlockedPowerShellCommandSegment`, `isSafeSegment`, `isSafePowerShellSegment`) | Same review: with `make` › `lint` configured, `make lint; rm -rf src` and `make lint > file` passed |

## Updating

Diff the new published package against the 0.58.3 tarball, apply the upstream changes to this
copy, and re-apply every `// prism-fork:` patch.
